title: 2007-11-12: General Parviz Jafari UFO Testimony
description:
This is the National Press Club "testimony" of Iranian F-4 pilot Major Parviz Jafari, now General Parviz Jafari (amazing self control to achieve that from Shah to Revolution) who was present for the 18-19 September 1976 Tehran UFO Incident.  Americans should keep in mind that this event took place prior to the events of the Iranian Revolution from 1978-1979.  

The 1976 Tehran UFO event was a radar and visual sighting of an unidentified flying object over Iran's capital city, Tehran, during the early morning hours of 19 September 1976. 

Pilots of two Iranian Air Force F-4 Phantom II's reported losing instrumentation and communications as they approached the object. When they withdrew from its proximity, the electronics were restored.

One pilot, Parviz Jafari, reported a temporary weapons systems failure while the two man crew was preparing to open fire on the unknown object.
